sample_gate.seed_row_selection: use exactly the immutable prediction_key frozen in the V1.1 127-key seed manifest
sample_gate.future_row_selection: for each non-seed event, require created_at_utc strictly after V1_1_FREEZE_UTC and select the earliest qualifying immutable prediction ordered by created_at_utc ASC, prediction_time_utc ASC, snapshot_time_utc ASC, prediction_key ASC
sample_gate.event_order: kickoff_utc ASC, event_id ASC, prediction_key ASC
sample_gate.primary_prefix: for each league, use the smallest deterministic prefix of selected events that contains at least 100 unique events and at least 4 distinct UTC kickoff calendar months

post_gate_settlement.permanent_cancel_abandon_void_policy: exclude only after an authoritative non-performance status is available; never use prediction correctness or metric contribution as an exclusion reason
post_gate_settlement.replacement_policy: extend the same deterministic event-order prefix with the next eligible captured events until each league has at least 100 scorable events while retaining at least 4 kickoff calendar months
post_gate_settlement.postponed_fixture_policy: retain and wait for canonical completion unless it becomes authoritatively cancelled/abandoned/void

evaluation.primary_interpretation: descriptive frozen market baseline; no arbitrary PASS/FAIL threshold is introduced for MARKET_ONLY itself
